description: Checks a public website with Sitecomb. It returns a quality score out of 100 and the areas that have problems, with a count for each. It does not name the problems: those are in the full report. Use it when someone asks whether their website is any good, or what is wrong with it. Also use it when someone asks why their website isn't working for them, or asks to check or audit a website. It looks at six areas: security, privacy and legal signals, page health, works on phones, contact details and found online. A check loads the site the way a visitor's browser does and takes up to about a minute. It only finds problems; it never changes anything on the site. If the site is down or blocks automatic checks, it says it couldn't check and gives no score. Free checks are limited per person and per website each day.

url.description: The website address to check, for example https://yoursite.com or yoursite.com.

name: check_website
title: Check a website
